extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, patent attorneys, applicants, and other practitioners involved in Japanese patent and utility model prosecution
extracted.subtask_description: The Japan Patent Office's Examination Guidelines for Patent and Utility Model: an official, chapter-by-chapter set of standards and procedures used to examine patent and utility model applications in Japan, covering patentability, description and claims requirements, amendments, priority, special application types, foreign-language and international filings, and utility models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principles of Examination and Flow of Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: General principles governing examination and the procedural flow of examination (Chapter 1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Chapter 1 (PDF) for detailed flowcharts and principles used by examiners during examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedures of Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural rules covering the conduct of examinations (Part I, Chapter 2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes multiple sections addressing how specific examination steps should be performed (see linked sections).

rubrics_metrics.name: Specifying Claimed Invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and guidance on how the claimed invention should be specified for examination purposes (Section 1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See PDF for criteria used to determine what the claims encompass and how to interpret them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior Art Search and Determination of Novelty, Inventive Step, etc.
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on performing prior art searches and determining novelty and inventive step (Section 2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains methodologies and examiner practice for assessing novelty and inventive step; see full section PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Reasons for Refusal
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for issuing a Notice of Reasons for Refusal to an applicant (Section 3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes content and format expectations for notices; see section for exemplars and required elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling of Written Opinion, Written Amendment, etc.
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on how written opinions and written amendments from applicants should be handled in examination (Section 4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes procedural timing and formality requirements for written interactions; see PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural and substantive standards for decisions to grant a patent or take other actions (Section 5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See section for decision-making processes and required findings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision of Dismissal of Amendment
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and procedure for dismissing an amendment proposed by an applicant (Section 6).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains when amendments may be refused and the procedural steps for dismissal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reconsideration by Examiners before Appeal Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Process and standards for examiner reconsideration prior to formal appeal (Section 7).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes how reconsideration requests are handled and what factors examiners review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communication with Applicant and Request for Documents etc. Required for the Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for communication with applicants and the types of documents that may be requested during examination (Section 8).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers timing, content, and manner of examiner-applicant communication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enablement Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(4)(i))
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that the description enables a person skilled in the art to carry out the invention (Enablement).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part II, Chapter 1 Section 1 for detailed tests, examples, and examiner practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ministerial Ordinance Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(4)(i))
rubrics_metrics.description: Statutory/ordinance-based requirements for descriptions as specified under Article 36(4)(i).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed in Part II, Chapter 1 alongside enablement guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Disclosure of Information on Prior Art Documents (Patent Act Article 36(4)(ii))
rubrics_metrics.description: Obligations for the description to disclose information about relevant prior art documents (Article 36(4)(ii)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the chapter for how and when prior art disclosure is expected in the description.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Claims (Patent Act Article 36(5))
rubrics_metrics.description: General statutory requirement(s) for claims under Article 36(5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part II, Chapter 2 Section 1 contains further explanation and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(6)(i))
rubrics_metrics.description: Claims must be supported by the description (support requirement under Article 36(6)(i)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part II, Chapter 2 Section 2 for tests and examples of sufficient support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(6)(ii))
rubrics_metrics.description: Claims must be clear and unambiguous (clarity requirement under Article 36(6)(ii)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part II, Chapter 2 Section 3 sets out interpretation principles and problematic claim language examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conciseness Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(6)(iii))
rubrics_metrics.description: Claims should be concise (conciseness requirement under Article 36(6)(iii)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See guidance for how multiple claims should be drafted and when redundancy is objectionable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ministerial Ordinance Requirement on Statement of Claims (Patent Act Article 36(6)(iv))
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal statement/formatting requirements for claims imposed by ministerial ordinance (Article 36(6)(iv)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical formatting and statement rules are provided in the linked section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of Invention (Patent Act Article 37)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that an application relates to one invention or a group of inventions linked so as to form a single general inventive concept (unity of invention under Article 37).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part II, Chapter 3 provides tests and examiner practice; also includes a reference 'Requirements for Unity of Application' for older-applicable rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility for Patent and Industrial Applicability (Main Paragraph of Article 29(1) of Patent Act)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for whether a subject matter is eligible for patenting and is industrially applicable (Article 29(1) main paragraph).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part III, Chapter 1 discusses excluded subject matter and applicability tests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty (Patent Act Article 29(1) and (2))
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and tests for novelty under Article 29(1) and (2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part III, Chapter 2 Section 1 contains detailed novelty rules, prior art definitions, and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive Step (Patent Act Article 29(1) and (2))
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and examiner practice for assessing inventive step (non-obviousness) under Article 29(1) and (2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part III, Chapter 2 Section 2 provides problem-solution approaches, obviousness tests, and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure of Determining Novelty and Inventive Step
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural steps and methods used by examiners to determine novelty and inventive step (Part III, Chapter 2 Section 3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains order of analysis, selection and combination of prior art, and legal thresholds applied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims Including Specific Expressions
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on examining claims that include particular expressions or formulations (Part III, Chapter 2 Section 4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses special wording such as function-oriented language, numerical ranges, and Markush-type claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exceptions to Lack of Novelty of Invention (Patent Act Article 30)
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances where disclosure does not destroy novelty under Article 30 (exceptions to lack of novelty).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part III, Chapter 2 Section 5 details statutory exceptions and required evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secret Prior Art (Patent Act Article 29bis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Treatment and rules concerning secret prior art under Article 29bis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part III, Chapter 3 explains how secret prior art is identified and its effect on patentability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior Application (Patent Act Article 39)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for handling prior applications that affect patentability (Article 39).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part III, Chapter 4 contains procedural and substantive guidance on priority between applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category of Unpatentable Invention (Patent Act Article 32)
rubrics_metrics.description: Enumerated categories of subject matter that are unpatentable under Article 32.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part III, Chapter 5 lists categories and provides examples of excluded inventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Amendments (Patent Act Article 17bis)
rubrics_metrics.description: General statutory requirements governing amendments to description, claims, or drawings (Article 17bis).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part IV, Chapter 1 outlines permissible amendments and formal requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment Adding New Matter (Patent Act Article 17bis(3))
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules relating to amendments that would add matter not originally disclosed (prohibition under Article 17bis(3)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part IV, Chapter 2 explains how new matter is identified and when amendments are disallowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment Changing Special Technical Feature of Invention (Patent Act Article 17bis(4))
rubrics_metrics.description: Restrictions on amendments that change a special technical feature of the invention (Article 17bis(4)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part IV, Chapter 3 provides examples and the test for when a special technical feature change is impermissible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment for other than the Prescribed Purposes (Patent Act Article 17bis(5))
rubrics_metrics.description: Limitations on amendments made for purposes other than those prescribed (Article 17bis(5)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part IV, Chapter 4 describes improper amendment motives and consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority under the Paris Convention
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and requirements for claiming foreign priority under the Paris Convention (Part V, Chapter 1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains time limits, required evidence, and effects of priority claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internal Priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Domestic/internal priority rules and requirements (Part V, Chapter 2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers conditions under which an earlier domestic filing confers priority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Division of Patent Application (Patent Act Article 44)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for dividing a patent application into divisional applications (Article 44).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part VI Chapter 1 includes 'Requirements for Division of Patent Application' and related procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Division of Patent Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific criteria that must be met for a divisional application to be allowable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Part VI, Chapter 1 Section 1 for procedural timing and content requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice under Article 50bis
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and content for notices issued under Article 50bis (Part VI Chapter 1 Section 2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details the circumstances and effects of such notices on applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion of Application (Patent Act Article 46)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for converting one type of application into another under Article 46 (Part VI Chapter 2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains permissible conversions and procedural steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Application Based on Utility Model Registration (Patent Act Article 46bis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on filing patent applications based on prior utility model registration (Article 46bis).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part VI Chapter 3 sets out formal and substantive requirements for such filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference filing (Patent Act Article 38ter)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for filing by reference under Article 38ter (Part VI Chapter 4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains allowable content and legal effects of reference filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overview of Foreign Language Written Application System
rubrics_metrics.description: Summary of the foreign language application system and how it operates in Japan (Part VII Chapter 1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides general rules and rationale for accepting foreign-language filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of Foreign Language Written Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed procedures and standards for examining applications filed in a foreign language (Part VII Chapter 2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Large section covering translation, timing, document requirements, and examiner practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: International Patent Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and procedures relating to international (PCT) patent applications entering/handled in Japan (Part VIII).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes reception, examination, and national phase entry requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension of a Patent Term as Compensation for the Curtailment of the Term (Patent Act Article 67(2))
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and procedures to extend a patent term as compensation for curtailment under Article 67(2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part IX Chapter 1 contains eligibility tests and calculation methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension of Patent Term for Pharmaceutical Inventions (Patent Act Article 67(4))
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific rules for extending patent terms for pharmaceutical inventions under Article 67(4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part IX Chapter 2 addresses special provisions applicable to pharmaceuticals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basic Requirements for Utility Model Registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Core statutory and practical requirements for registering utility models (Part X Chapter 1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes scope, formal requirements, and technical criteria distinct from patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Utility Model Technical Opinion
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for issuing technical opinions on utility models (Part X Chapter 2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains examiner practice for technical opinion issuance and content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling Procedures for Examinations involving Product-by-process Claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific handling and examination procedures for product-by-process claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate linked page provides detailed treatment for product-by-process claim examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Unity of Application (reference for older applications)
rubrics_metrics.description: Historical/reference rules applied to applications filed on or before December 31, 2003 regarding unity of application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provided as a reference document for legacy filings; see the referenced PDF for details.
